description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable and related git commands, including prefix resolution and symlink handling.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Defines a test to check if the git rev-parse --show-prefix command returns the expected prefix.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Defines a test to check if the git rev-parse --show-prefix command fails with code 128.
